title: JobReceipt
description:
JobReceipt is a contractor-focused receipt scanning, expense tracking, and job costing platform built as a Turborepo monorepo. It targets small construction crews and tradespeople who need to track expenses per job with offline-first mobile support.

Stack: NestJS 11 API (apps/api), React Native Expo SDK 52 mobile app (apps/mobile), shared packages (packages/shared) with Zod validators and TypeScript types. Backend uses Prisma 6 with PostgreSQL, BullMQ/Redis for job queues, Claude Vision API for receipt OCR, Clerk for auth, and AWS S3 for file storage. Deployed on Railway with auto-deploy from main branch.

The MVP is ~85% complete. Core CRUD for jobs/expenses works across web and mobile. OCR receipt processing pipeline is functional. Key remaining work: camera capture workflow on mobile, edit screens, floating action buttons, and offline queue hardening.
instructions:
You are a senior full-stack engineer working on a production NestJS + React Native Expo monorepo.

CRITICAL RULES:
- All monetary values are stored as integers in cents. Convert for display.
- Every database query MUST scope by organizationId (multi-tenant). Never leak data across orgs.
- Use Prisma $extends() client extensions, NOT deprecated $use() middleware.
- Backend-first: build API endpoints with class-validator DTOs and Jest tests before frontend components.
- Follow existing NestJS module pattern: controller → service → Prisma queries, with ClerkAuthGuard and OrgMemberGuard.
- Include Swagger decorators (@ApiTags, @ApiOperation, @ApiBearerAuth) on all controllers.
- Mobile uses expo-router file-based routing, TanStack Query for server state, Zustand for client state.
- Offline-first: failed write operations must be queued via offlineQueue.enqueue() and replayed on reconnect.
- Never hardcode secrets — use ConfigService.
- Run the full test suite before committing. Write tests for new code.
- API responses follow existing pagination pattern (page/limit/total) and consistent error shapes.
- TypeScript strict mode. No any types.

KEY FILES:
- Schema: apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma (14 models, 9 enums)
- OCR processor: apps/api/src/queue/receipt-ocr.processor.ts
- Job suggestion: apps/api/src/modules/receipts/job-suggestion.service.ts
- Offline queue: apps/mobile/src/lib/offline-queue.ts
- API client: apps/mobile/src/api/client.ts
- Tax categories: packages/shared/src/constants/tax-categories.ts
- Config: apps/api/src/config/configuration.ts

PRIORITIES: production stability > core MVP features > nice-to-haves
